query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools;
result: 17686 rows.
validation_method: direct row count via read-only sqlite3

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm;
result: 9986 rows.
validation_method: direct row count via read-only sqlite3

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores;
result: 2269 rows.
validation_method: direct row count via read-only sqlite3

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE CDSCode LIKE '%0000000';
result: 1369 rows whose CDS code ends in seven zeros; these are the agency-level administrative records.
validation_method: pattern count on the primary key

query: SELECT SUM(School IS NULL), SUM(Street IS NULL), SUM(City IS NULL), SUM(Zip IS NULL), SUM(State IS NULL) FROM schools;
result: School name empty for 1369 rows; Street 294, City 293, Zip 293 and State 293 empty. The two null counts coincide, so the records without a school name are the same records without an address.

query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode);
result: 9986 FRPM rows, 9986 matched. Every meal record links to a registry row by direct text equality of the CDS code.

query: SELECT DISTINCT length(CDSCode) FROM schools; SELECT DISTINCT rtype, length(cds) FROM satscores;
result: schools.CDSCode is always 14 characters. satscores.cds is 13 characters for part of the records and 14 for the rest, because the leading zero of county codes below 10 is dropped.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON t.cds=s.CDSCode;
result: 2058 of 2269 SAT records match by direct text equality; 211 records fail to match (53 district-level and 158 school-level).

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON CAST(s.CDSCode AS INTEGER)=CAST(t.cds AS INTEGER);
result: 2269 of 2269 SAT records match when the identifiers are compared numerically.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON printf('%014d',CAST(t.cds AS INTEGER))=s.CDSCode;
result: 2269 of 2269 SAT records match after zero-padding the SAT identifier to 14 characters.

query: SELECT CDSCode, substr(CDSCode,1,2), substr(CDSCode,3,5), substr(CDSCode,8,7), `County Code`, `District Code`, `School Code` FROM frpm LIMIT 3;
result: The 14-character code decomposes exactly into a 2-digit county code, a 5-digit district code and a 7-digit school code, matching the separate county, district and school code columns of the meal table.
validation_method: substring comparison against the component columns

query: SELECT rtype, COUNT(*) FROM satscores GROUP BY 1;
result: S = 1749 school-level records, D = 520 district-level records.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON CAST(s.CDSCode AS INTEGER)=CAST(t.cds AS INTEGER) WHERE t.rtype='D' AND s.CDSCode LIKE '%0000000';
result: All 520 district-level SAT records join to registry rows whose CDS code ends in seven zeros, confirming that they aggregate agencies rather than school sites.

query: SELECT DISTINCT `Academic Year` FROM frpm; SELECT `Academic Year`, COUNT(*) FROM frpm GROUP BY 1;
result: A single value, '2014-2015', across all 9986 rows.

query: SELECT Virtual, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY 1;
SELECT Magnet, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.GSoffered='K-8' AND s.Magnet=1 AND f.`NSLP Provision Status`='Multiple Provision Types';
result: 1 school satisfies all three conditions simultaneously.

query: SELECT StatusType, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY 1;
result: Active 11708, Closed 4518, Merged 1448, Pending 12.

query: SELECT Charter, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY 1;
SELECT DISTINCT FundingType FROM schools; SELECT DISTINCT `Charter Funding Type` FROM frpm;
result: Both columns hold the same three labels: Directly funded, Locally funded, Not in CS funding model.

query: SELECT DISTINCT EdOpsCode, EdOpsName FROM schools ORDER BY EdOpsCode;
result: 13 pairs, including SSS = State Special School, TRAD = Traditional, CON = Continuation School, SPEC = Special Education School and OPP = Opportunity School.

query: SELECT DISTINCT `Educational Option Type`, COUNT(*) FROM frpm GROUP BY 1;
result: 13 labels matching the registry vocabulary; Traditional 8696, Continuation School 459, Alternative School of Choice 259, State Special School 3, and 45 rows empty.

query: SELECT DISTINCT DOC, DOCType FROM schools ORDER BY DOC;
result: 12 pairs including 52 = Elementary School District, 54 = Unified School District, 00 = County Office of Education (COE) and 31 = State Special Schools.

query: SELECT DISTINCT `District Type`, COUNT(*) FROM frpm GROUP BY 1;
result: 8 labels: Unified School District 6744, Elementary School District 2356, High School District 529, County Office of Education (COE) 334, and four smaller groups.

query: SELECT DISTINCT SOC, SOCType FROM schools ORDER BY SOC;
result: 19 pairs including 62 = Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public), 65 = K-12 Schools (Public), 66 = High Schools (Public), 60 = Elementary Schools (Public) and 31 = State Special Schools.

query: SELECT DISTINCT `School Type`, COUNT(*) FROM frpm GROUP BY 1;
result: 18 labels including Elementary Schools (Public) 5584, Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public) 1299, High Schools (Public) 1331, K-12 Schools (Public) 240, State Special Schools 3, and 45 rows empty.

query: SELECT DISTINCT GSoffered FROM schools; SELECT DISTINCT GSserved FROM schools;
result: Spans are compact boundary labels such as K-8, K-12, 9-12, P-5, 1-Adult and K; the served column uses the same vocabulary, with more single-grade values such as 12 and 1.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE GSoffered<>GSserved;
result: 2487 rows have an offered span different from the served span.
validation_method: comparison count between the two columns

query: SELECT SUM(GSoffered IS NULL), SUM(GSserved IS NULL), COUNT(*) FROM schools;
result: GSoffered empty for 3882 rows and GSserved empty for 5743 of 17686 rows.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE GSoffered='K-8'; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.City) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.GSoffered='K-8';
result: 1292 registry rows offer the span K-8, spread over 457 distinct cities among the schools that also appear in the meal table.

query: SELECT DISTINCT `NSLP Provision Status`, COUNT(*) FROM frpm GROUP BY 1;
result: Provision 2 1365, Breakfast Provision 2 285, CEP 172, Multiple Provision Types 11, Provision 1 7, Lunch Provision 2 5, Provision 3 2, and 8139 rows empty.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE OpenDate IS NULL;
result: 1369 rows have no open date; these coincide with the agency-level records.

query: SELECT OpenDate, COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE OpenDate LIKE '1980%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
result: 10679 rows share the date 1980-07-01, one row has 1980-09-01 and one has 1980-05-01. All other years have at most a few hundred records, so 1980-07-01 is a filler value.

query: SELECT ClosedDate FROM schools WHERE ClosedDate IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3;
result: Example values 2015-07-31, 2015-06-30 and 1989-06-30, in ISO date form.

query: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(ABS(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` - `Free Meal Count (K-12)`/`Enrollment (K-12)`) > 0.001) FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0;
result: 9972 comparable rows and 0 mismatches: the stored rate is exactly the free-meal count divided by the enrollment count of the same population label.

query: SELECT MIN(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`), MAX(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) FROM frpm;
result: Minimum about 0.00176 and maximum 1.0, confirming that the stored rates are fractions rather than values out of 100.

query: SELECT SUM(`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NULL), SUM(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` IS NULL), SUM(`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NULL), SUM(`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` IS NULL) FROM frpm;
result: Enrollment (K-12) empty for 0 rows, Free Meal Count (K-12) for 56, Enrollment (Ages 5-17) for 14 and Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17) for 78 of 9986 rows.

query: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(`Enrollment (K-12)`<>`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`), SUM(`Enrollment (K-12)`>`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL;
result: 9972 comparable rows; the two figures differ in 6460 rows, always with the K-12 figure larger. The two population labels are therefore genuinely distinct.

query: SELECT SUM(School IS NULL), SUM(Street IS NULL), SUM(City IS NULL), SUM(Zip IS NULL), SUM(State IS NULL), SUM(MailStreet IS NULL), SUM(MailCity IS NULL) FROM schools;
result: Street 294, City 293, Zip 293, State 293, MailStreet 292 and MailCity 292 empty rows out of 17686.

query: SELECT DISTINCT State FROM schools;
result: The only value is 'CA'.

query: SELECT DISTINCT Zip FROM schools LIMIT 8;
result: Values appear both as five digits (94541) and in ZIP+4 form (94544-1136, 94612-3355).

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE Street<>MailStreet AND MailStreet IS NOT NULL;
result: 2989 rows have a mailing street different from the location street.

query: SELECT MIN(Latitude), MAX(Latitude), MIN(Longitude), MAX(Longitude) FROM schools;
result: Latitude 32.547737 to 44.219305; Longitude -124.28481 to -83.781133, negative for every record because California lies in the western hemisphere.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE Latitude IS NULL;
result: 4823 of 17686 rows have no coordinates.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE AdmEmail1 LIKE '%_@_%.__%';
result: 11674 rows carry an e-mail-like value in the first administrator slot; 6012 rows have no value there, which includes the 1369 agency records and many school-site records.

query: SELECT DISTINCT AdmEmail1 FROM schools WHERE AdmEmail1 LIKE '%@%' LIMIT 5;
result: Example addresses such as lkmonroe@acoe.org and laura@envisionacademy.org; the column is free text, so it can also hold strings that are not well-formed addresses.

query: SELECT SUM(NumTstTakr IS NULL), SUM(NumGE1500 IS NULL), SUM(AvgScrMath IS NULL), SUM(enroll12 IS NULL), COUNT(*) FROM satscores;
result: Out of 2269 records, NumTstTakr is never empty, enroll12 is never empty, while NumGE1500 and the three average score columns are empty for 596 records.

query: SELECT s.SOCType, COUNT(*) FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON CAST(s.CDSCode AS INTEGER)=CAST(t.cds AS INTEGER) WHERE t.rtype='S' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
result: School-level SAT coverage is concentrated: High Schools (Public) 1234, K-12 Schools (Public) 228, Alternative Schools of Choice 177, Continuation High Schools 87, with the remaining categories in single digits.

query: SELECT DISTINCT s.County, f.`County Name` FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.County LIKE '%Monterey%';
result: The county name is identical in both tables ('Monterey'), confirming that county and district are stored as plain shared labels.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE City='Monterey';
result: 16 registry rows are located in a city named Monterey, so the city label alone does not determine the county.

query: SELECT CDSCode, School, City, EdOpsCode, EdOpsName, SOC, SOCType, GSoffered FROM schools WHERE EdOpsCode='SSS';
result: Three schools: California School for the Blind (Fremont), California School for the Deaf-Fremont and California School for the Deaf-Riverside. All three carry SOC code 31.
